task.title: Create durable one-shot schedule intent
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/831 by exposing the existing inert schedule creation boundary through an explicit writable CLI command.
acceptance_criteria: Validate caller-owned identity, goal, and due syntax before avoidable storage effects.
Persist one pending intent and emit its complete deterministic projection.
Reject duplicates without rewriting original intent or adding execution authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Three creation tests failed because create was not a recognized schedule subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the required success, absence or conflict, validation, and fail-closed paths.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded contract and refactored only demonstrated duplication.
attempts.diagnostic: The capability existed below the requested boundary or required one new typed kernel operation.
attempts.patch: Added a thin adapter over ScheduleStore::schedule and strengthened duplicate diagnostics and invalid-due pre-storage coverage.

outcome.summary: Callers can create one durable inert schedule intent while dispatch, clock, retry, and execution remain outside the CLI.

lessons: A writable command should grant only the smallest explicit append authority.
Duplicate rejection must preserve the original durable intent and should be asserted directly.
